# `task_route_options`

**Read a task's routing options.** Report whether the task is routed, whether its class is explicit, and which class, provider and profile combinations could execute it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `task_route_options` |
| Side effect | `read` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
| Defined in | [`src/commands/contracts/builtin.py`](../../../src/commands/contracts/builtin.py) |
| Contract fingerprint | `sha256:3fc6f54c3541409ee70cf3eca52e4bd65cf7b8191fa122855d851aac7794b06f` |
